pins.title: Beach sign activity for kids: explain one wildlife-safe action in eight words
pins.description: Can a child design a sign people understand in five seconds? Pick one action, such as giving shorebirds space. Draw one clear picture and use no more than eight words. Show someone for five seconds and ask what they think the sign means. Try the free beach sign activity.
